partners.name: Gohar Afarinan Farda — Gold & Jewelry
partners.description: Gohar Afarinan Farda is an Iranian company specializing in gold and jewelry services, consulting, training, and innovation. As a NovaNest affiliate, it helps gold-industry entrepreneurs explore opportunities to expand or relocate their businesses abroad, especially to Canada.
about: Gohar Afarinan Farda is an Iranian company specializing in gold and jewelry services, consulting, training, and innovation. With more than 20 years of experience, a team of over 30 specialists, and 50+ successful projects serving more than 1,000 satisfied clients across 8 branches in Iran, the company is a recognized pioneer in the gold and jewelry industry.

The company brings together deep industry experience, modern technology, and a network of trusted partner brands — including 18 Ayar, Baharan, Goharan, Nabat, Romis, and Sarourian — across design, production, product development, marketing, and distribution.

As a NovaNest affiliate, Gohar Afarinan Farda connects us with gold-industry entrepreneurs who want to expand or relocate their business abroad — especially to Canada. Together, we help these entrepreneurs pave their path to launching and growing a gold business in Canada.
services: Professional training and education for gold-industry businesses
